provider.meaning: Legacy provider override. Null selects the default provider; on omission the standing choice applies. A VPN flag wins over this alias.

flags.meaning: Payload-carried flags; VPN options can also ride in the envelope flags. The envelope carrier wins over the payload carrier, and flags.vpn wins over flags.exousia.vpn within each carrier.

vpn.meaning: Overrides the standing Transmission VPN options field by field. A null family resets all options to the primitive.

protocol.meaning: Provider protocol override; null selects openvpn for PIA.

region.meaning: Provider region ID. Null leaves automatic region selection; an explicit ID must resolve at the provider where a provider endpoint is selected.

dip.meaning: Request a dedicated IP; null selects false.

dns.meaning: Use provider DNS; null selects the public resolver in the namespace setup.

rescan.meaning: Request the RPC torrent rescan after applying download settings; null selects false.

deadline_seconds.meaning: Onness wait in seconds, strictly greater than zero and at most 180.

provider.meaning: Selected provider, or null if selection did not complete.

steps.meaning: Operation or observation rows, each carrying step, observed, could-change, attempt and finalState.

failedRung.meaning: Rung at which the operation stopped.

failedCommandError.meaning: Signal and step identifying the failed command or operation.

field.meaning: Name of the invalid VPN option.

providers.meaning: Provider names from the VPN declaration.

onness.meaning: Latest status observation; a successful poll has every condition true.

on.meaning: True only when all five conditions hold.

namespace.meaning: Namespace exists and its veth is up.

forward.meaning: Hold is active and the forward state is fresh.

daemon.meaning: The native daemon unit is active.

peerPort.meaning: Fresh peer-port readback matches the forward port.

rpcPort.meaning: RPC port from the Transmission portal row, or null if not read.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome or first unmet condition of the sampled status.

failedStep.meaning: Onness step on a wait that expired.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The stop’s outcome token; none when no signal is missing.
